 Klay Thompson sends strong message to Steph Curry, Warriors ahead of reunion clash 
 2026-11-05 23:16 
 Klay Thompson can't wait to face and possibly beat Stephen Curry and the Warriors on their upcoming reunion game.
 Credit: AP-Scanpix 
 Credit AP-Scanpix 
 Credit AP-Scanpix

 Klay Thompson is simply excited to meet Stephen Curry and the Golden State Warriors again on the opposite side of the court.

 During his walk-off interview after his game-winning three-pointer to save the Miami Heat in overtime against the LA Clippers on Wednesday, Thompson offered a strong message against the Dubs ahead of their Thursday reunion game at Chase Center.
 "Hopefully I can continue to stay afloat because I made a lot of buckets in that building," Thompson said. "It's fun to beat up on old friends, so that would be awesome to come away with a back-to-back win."
 Klay Thompson seeking win for Heat vs. Warriors
 An undisputed core member of the Dubs dynasty, Thursday night would mark the eighth appearance of Klay Thompson as an opponent for the Golden State Warriors. He faced the Warriors in all of these when he was a member of the Dallas Mavericks.
 But this time around, he will be wearing a different uniform. Coming off his late-game heroics and an impressive 30-point display to beat the LA Clippers, Thompson will look to help the Miami Heat get their second consecutive win by beating the Warriors.
 After a rough season start, Thompson is already figuring it out for Miami. Across the past three games, he is averaging 24.7 points, 2.3 assists, and 2.0 rebounds while shooting a red-hot 57.4% from the field (52.8% from three).
 As Thompson aims to beat them, the Warriors will eventually look to extend their win streak to six amid a strong 5-3 run to start the season.
